req.title: Update form GET returns 200 for author
req.statement: The system shall serve the update form at GET /<id>/update when the current user is the post's author.
triggers: update form get returns 200 for author

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the update form should be accessible via a GET request at the endpoint /<id>/update only if the current user is the author of the post. This implies that we need to test for correct authorization, proper HTTP status codes, and boundary conditions around user permissions.

tests.name: test_update_form_get_author
preconditions: User is the author of the post
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'Test Body'})

# Fetch the post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = int(r.data.split(b'data-id="')[1].split(b'"')[0])

# Test: Access update form as author
r = client.get(f'/{post_id}/update')
assert r.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_update_form_get_non_author
preconditions: User is not the author of the post
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'Test Body'})

# Fetch the post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = int(r.data.split(b'data-id="')[1].split(b'"')[0])

# Logout and register a new user
client.get('/auth/logout')
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Test: Attempt to access update form as non-author
r = client.get(f'/{post_id}/update')
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'Test Body'})

# Fetch the post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = int(r.data.split(b'data-id="')[1].split(b'"')[0])

# Logout
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Test: Attempt to access update form with no user logged in
r = client.get(f'/{post_id}/update')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']
